subject: fix(replay): a boundary keeps the record's own name for it
instruction:
fix(replay): a boundary keeps the record's own name for it

`Record.prompt/2` refuses an attachment-bearing prompt with
`{:prompt_attachments, n}` — the record names each attachment and holds none of
their bytes, so the message the model was sent cannot be reassembled — and that
refusal was being wrapped in a second `{:unreplayable, …}` on the way out. On the
wire it read as `reason: "unreplayable"` with the real answer inspected into
`detail`, which is a reader having to unpeel two layers to learn one fact. The
record's own name is now the boundary's name, and the case is pinned.

Acceptance. These tests are restored into the worktree after the session ends and must pass:
  - a prompt whose attachments the record only names is bounded, not guessed at

Rules. Files that already exist under `test/` must not be modified or deleted — the change is graded against tests restored from the history after the session ends. New test files of your own are allowed and are left in place. Work only inside this worktree.
